verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an online business-filing service, since such services can expose APIs with test modes. Nothing in the evidence shows LegalZoom offers a sandbox, test mode, or any way to exercise its services without making real filings. The evidence covers only consumer-facing filing, registered-agent, compliance and dashboard features, plus an llms.txt crawler-guidance file, which is unrelated to sandboxed testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
